purpose: Close the exact Git-index backlog for every evidence file referenced by the current goal audit without bulk-adding unrelated workspace content.

allowlist_source.selection_rule: Take the sorted set difference between evidence paths referenced by all goal requirements and git ls-files; accept only files whose initial bytes match the already declared SHA-256, then normalize five Markdown-only trailing-space date lines and rebind their final hashes.

categories: proposal provenance, acquisition power and fresh-protocol design audits
release allowlist, source-closure, publisher and environment audits

decision.permitted_claim: Every file referenced by the goal audit is present with its declared bytes in the candidate Git index after an exact 34-file allowlist addition.
decision.prohibited_claim: Index closure does not establish redistribution rights, a selected license, runnable producers, dependency completeness, solver availability, clean-clone execution or history safety.

remaining_release_gates: author-selected root license and third-party attribution policy
canonical content-addressed skill and library manifests
required solver submodule and external Gurobi contract
history-free or sanitized public release construction
